## Overview

The Guild of the Spark is the church of the **God of Forge and Arcana** — patron of artisans, smiths, inventors, and mages. Its temples are workshops, forges, and arcane libraries where craft and magic are studied as sacred pursuits.

## Structure

The Guild operates more like a craft guild than a traditional church. Its clergy are smiths, enchanters, and engineers who create magical items and teach apprentices. The Guild has strong ties to **Emberforge**, where its smith-priests bless weapons and armor produced for the Last Stand military.

## Membership

- **Smith-Priests**: Clerics who combine forging with divine magic
- **Enchanters**: Artificers and mages who create magical items
- **Artificers**: Engineers who blend craft and arcane theory
- **Apprentices**: Learners who study under master crafters

## Goals

- Advance the arts of smithing, enchanting, and engineering
- Bless and improve the equipment of the Last Stand military
- Preserve and advance arcane knowledge
- Train the next generation of crafters and mages

## Headquarters

The Guild's main temple is located in **Emberforge**, with chapter houses in Weaveheart and Skywatch.
